hook_line: GOLD RETURNED 60% LAST DIWALI AND 13% THIS ONE; ANALYSTS TARGET $5,000 NEXT

stats.label: Domestic gold's return in 2026, to November 5
Record spot gold an ounce on January 29

diaspora_bullets: Gold beat the Nifty in each of the last five Diwali-to-Diwali years
Experts advise staggered buying on dips, not one Dhanteras purchase
news_summary: Domestic gold returned 60.21% Diwali-to-Diwali in 2025 but 12.87% in 2026, reaching Rs 1,43,184 by November 5, according to Mirae Asset Sharekhan data.
payoff: Analysts' shared advice for Samvat 2083 is staggered buying, treating gold as a diversifier rather than a trade.
